title: Rollback sentinel with probabilistic trigger and reconciliation playbook
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a production-ready 'Rollback Sentinel' that automatically pauses or reverts unsafe or cost-regressive config changes while minimizing false positives and avoiding cascading rollbacks. This ticket covers the probabilistic trigger model, guardrail definition, state snapshotting, and reconciliation playbook used to safely apply or undo changes to batching/caching and runtime config options.

Context: We've seen config rollouts (batch size, KV cache TTLs, kernel selection overrides) cause intermittent latency regressions and token-cost spikes. The sentinel must integrate with existing rollout engine and provide deterministic fallback plus a reconciliation subsystem that ensures cluster state converges after a revert.

Design summary: 
- Multi-signal trigger: combine short-term SLO breaches (p95 latency, error rate), economic signals (tokens/sec cost delta), and internal health (queue growth, GPU utilization) into a probabilistic alert score.
- Probabilistic trigger: compute a rolling Bayesian score that increases with correlated signals; only fire automated pause/revert when posterior probability of harmful change > threshold (default 0.9) AND a persistence/hysteresis window is violated (e.g., 3 samples over 5m). This reduces flapping and overreactions.
- Guardrails: minimum test population (canary traffic >= 2% or >= 50 qps), circuit-breaker cooldown (default 15m), staged actions (PAUSE -> PARTIAL_REVERT -> FULL_REVERT), and manual escalation path.
- Snapshot & snapshot-hash: before any config change, capture lightweight state snapshot (config hash, binary diff reference, KV cache checkpoints for warm nodes) stored in S3 with TTL and immutability tag. Snapshots used to produce deterministic rollback playbook.
- Reconciliation engine: after a revert, run a state harmonizer that verifies node-level config, warms KV cache from snapshot prefixes, and reconciles routing tables. Reconciliation must be idempotent and report a convergence score.
- Safety sims: offline Monte Carlo regressions with historical workload replay to tune thresholds and estimate false-positive/false-negative tradeoffs.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Sentinel computes combined posterior score and can trigger automated PAUSE/PARTIAL_REVERT/FULL_REVERT for a staged rollout.
- State snapshots created reliably for all rollout types and used by rollback playbooks to restore node config & cache warmers.
- Reconciliation runs after revert, produces convergence score >= 0.95 within configured timeout for 95% of test clusters.
- Integrations: Console shows sentinel decision path (signals, score, action) and provides one-click manual revert/confirm. Audit log entry for every automatic action with snapshot reference and PR/rollout id.
- Security review completed for snapshot storage and access to KMS/HSM keys.

Telemetry & observability: track sentinel_score, trigger_count, auto_reverts, time_to_converge, false_positive_rate (simulated), and customer_affected_count. Expose per-rollout breakdown and link to cost-delta analysis.

Rollout plan: feature-flag gated; start with internal clusters only, then internal canaries (5%), paid customer canaries (opt-in), then global default. Default action initially PAUSE-only for 2 weeks before enabling PARTIAL_REVERT.

Test plan: unit tests for scoring model, e2e simulation job running on replay datasets, a staged canary run with synthetic latency spikes to validate behavior, and chaos tests to ensure no deadlock in reconciliation.

Notes & constraints: snapshots must be small and encrypted; do not store PII. Reconciliation must not violate tenant isolation in Dedicated/Private modes. Work with Security/Legal for retention policy.

2026-03-04 - Design review: agreed to use Bayesian posterior for combined signals; trade-off: slightly higher compute for better calibration. Action: ENG to prototype online updater for priors.

2026-03-05 - Engineering note: prototyped scoring service (go) with mock telemetry; results show 30% fewer false triggers vs simple threshold on p95. Draft code in repo: github.com/redwood-inference/sentinel (PR #582).
2026-03-06 - Security: determined snapshot storage must use customer-specific KMS keys for Private deployments. Security review ticket created: ENG-95734.

2026-03-07 - QA: ran replay of March-1 workload against staged config change; sentinel paused rollout at 6m mark; team observed queue growth stabilized after partial revert. Follow-up: add GPU utilization weighting to score.
2026-03-09 - Ops: simulated multi-region failover; reconciliation ran but convergence took longer (avg 12m). Action: add parallel warm-up tasks and increase cool-down config per region.
2026-03-10 - PM review: approved feature-flag rollout plan. Requested dashboard tile for 'sentinel_decision_log' and explicit user-facing explanation in Console when an auto-action occurs.
